summary: Improve municipal collection, route, cost, and contractor performance skills. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Municipal solid-waste operations training helps service teams assess collection coverage and improve day-to-day delivery. It is designed for municipal environment officers, waste-service managers, planners, and contractor supervisors, with practical work on mapping coverage gaps, reviewing routes and transfer operations, and analysing costs. Participants also practise checking contractor performance and selecting indicators for service reporting and improvement priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, operate, supervise, or advise on urban solid-waste collection and recovery services.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with municipal services, waste collection, contractor operations, or urban planning is recommended. No coding or programming is required. A laptop with Excel access is useful for costing exercises; QGIS is a free, open-source option for mapping, subject to your organization’s installation policies. The course uses sample operational scenarios, and no participant dataset is assumed.
